=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/ci.yml (same code in .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml and .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml)
  Line or code reference: ci.yml:1878 and 1880 (mark-stable.yml:421 and 423).
  severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The two new `grep` lookups for `shard_fail_matches` have no `-a`.
  WHY: Without `-a`, GNU grep prints a single `Binary file /tmp/poll_shard_N.log matches` line when the log contains a NUL byte before a match. `shard_fail_matches` then has one entry, the TEST_CASE_EVENT fallback is skipped, and `shard_failure_lines` gets "shard N: Binary file ... matches" instead of the test name.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml (same code in the two release-gate workflows)
  Line or code reference: ci.yml:1937-1939.
  severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The line is cut to 400 characters and then `%` is escaped.
  WHY: A message made mostly of `%` characters grows from 400 to at most 1200 characters after escaping, so the 400-character cap does not bound the annotation length.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .github/workflows/ci.yml, .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml, .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml
  Line or code reference: All lookups of `FAIL` lines (e.g., `grep -E '^[[:space:]]*FAIL[[:space:]]'`)
  severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Missing `-a` flag in `grep` lookups for failure lines.
  WHY: If a shard log contains NUL bytes, `grep` treats the file as binary and fails to match valid `FAIL` lines, which can lead to reporting that no failures were found despite a shard having failed, thus degrading diagnosability.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml, .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml, .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml
  Line or code reference: Annotation printing block (e.g., ci.yml lines 1937-1939)
  severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Escaping `%` and `\r` after cutting to 400 characters can exceed the workflow-command size budget.
  WHY: A 400-character failure line consisting of `%` characters would expand to 1200 characters after escaping, which exceeds the ~1KB GitHub workflow-command budget, potentially causing the entire annotation to be dropped by the runner.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml, .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml, .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml
  Line or code reference: `echo "::error::orchestrate-poll failing test: ${shard_failure_line}"`
  severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Untrusted failure lines (potentially including `::` sequences) are printed directly as workflow commands.
  WHY: If a failing test name or error message includes `::`, it may be interpreted by the workflow runner as a new workflow command, potentially allowing injection of further commands into the runner logs.
